searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: List of search queries to run on Google Maps (e.g. ['dentists in Calgary', 'plumbers in London'])

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max Results Per Query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of business results to process for each query.

maxWebsitePages.title: Max Website Pages to Crawl
maxWebsitePages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl on each business website to find emails.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel browser tabs. Recommended: 5-10 for 2GB+.

extractPlaceDetails.title: Add-on: Extract Place Details
extractPlaceDetails.description: If enabled, visits each business page to extract address, phone, ratings, reviews count, and opening hours. (Slower)

extractContacts.title: Add-on: Company Contacts Enrichment
extractContacts.description: If enabled, visits the business website (if found) to extract emails. (Fast)

extractSocialMedia.title: Add-on: Social Media Enrichment
extractSocialMedia.description: If enabled, extracts social media links (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Twitter) from the business website. Requires Contacts Enrichment to be enabled.
